text: Lebull is the betting brand of Southern Stingray, S.A., the SRIJ-licensed operator: the regulator's list of licensed entities gives LeBull (www.lebull.pt) with Southern Stingray, S.A. as its exploring entity under sports-betting licence 027.
short: Lebull is operated by SRIJ licensee Southern Stingray, S.A.

source.name: SRIJ (Turismo de Portugal), Entidades licenciadas - jogos e apostas online
source.quote: Marca: LeBull Website: www.lebull.pt Entidade exploradora: SOUTHERN STINGRAY, S.A.

additionalSources.name: Feeling Lucky: SRIJ emite duas licenças de jogo para novo operador em Portugal
additionalSources.quote: duas novas licenças de jogo – números 27 e 28 – à empresa Southern Stingray, S.A., que vai assim operar legalmente no nosso país sob a marca Lebull
